Strict Handstand Push-Ups

NOTES:
-Keeping it simple and low volume for deload week.
You should have a few reps left in the tank on each set.
- If you are unable to do strict handstand push-ups, perform box piked handstand push-ups.

workouts.title: Tempo Pause Front Squat
workouts.description:
Tempo Pause Front Squat
3x3 @ 12x1 Tempo / RPE 7
Rest 2:00-3:00 Between Sets.

NOTES:
- "12x1" means that you will take :01 to descend, :02 at the bottom, stand fast, and :01 at the top to reset between reps.
- This is a deload week. Build to a weight to use for all three sets that is moderate, but you could still do about three more reps if you wanted to on each set.
- Keep the pause at full depth. Stand straight up from the bottom of each rep with no bounce.
